issues.spec_citation: GLOBAL_RULES 'No Silent Fallbacks: Fail fast with typed exceptions'; SOF-VD-01 HISTORIAN (SQLOnFHIRError inherits ValueError)
issues.evidence: types.py validators (validate_sql_name, validate_required_string, validate_canonical_*) raise plain ValueError; at the direct-dataclass __post_init__ boundary the exception surfaces as ValueError, not typed ValidationError. The strict official-JSON parser boundary wraps every one of these into typed ParseError, and SQLOnFHIRError subclasses ValueError so catch behavior is identical. Probe: H1.dc.col/H1.dc.todict in .temp/qa/sof_vd10_skeptic_2026_08_23/probe.py.
issues.root_cause: Validators predate the typed-error doctrine; parser re-wraps at strict boundaries.
issues.resolution: INTENDED: no functional divergence; catchable as ValueError by contract (SOF-VD-01). No fix per Minimal Footprint.

issues.spec_citation: StructureDefinition-ViewDefinition.json (ig/2.0.0 releases): ViewDefinition.profile carries NO constraint in 2.0.0; FHIR canonical datatype regex \S*
issues.evidence: profile=['http://x|#'] and '|version' suffixed canonicals are ACCEPTED by validate_canonical_array. SD 2.0.0 snapshot defines no cnl-1 on ViewDefinition.profile; FHIR canonical form is <url>[|<version>[|<fragment>]] and the canonical regex is \S* (whitespace-only rejection is enforced). cnl-1 ('no | or #') is a warning-severity best-practice invariant in newer ballots and is enforced only on the strict single-value ViewDefinition.url path (validate_canonical_string). Probe H4.prof.*.
issues.resolution: INTENDED: matches 2.0.0 SD + canonical datatype rules; not a violation.
